name: LaBeau's (Garden City, UT) Golden Fried Clam Strips Basket (Cocktail Sauce Warning)
whyItWorks: Crisp clam strips are chewy and high in marine protein. Stick to mild tartar sauce; spicy horseradish cocktail sauce is a frequent trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Clam Strips basket with tartar sauce on the side and request no cocktail sauce.
watchOuts: Chewy clam meat requires thorough chewing
